mapper.sql: o.is_deleted = FALSE AND o.status = 2 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 2 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 2 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL), 0) AS paid_total, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 2 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND to_char(o.pay_time, 'YYYY-MM') = #{cycleKey}), 0) AS paid_this_month, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 2 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND to_char(o.pay_time, 'YYYY-MM') = #{cycleKey}) AS paid_orders_this_month, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 1) AS pending_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 1), 0) AS pending_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.tenant_code) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 2) AS paying_tenants FROM billing_order o WHERE o.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', o.pay_time), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(1) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS paid_amount FROM billing_order o WHERE
AND o.pay_time >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - make_interval(months => #{months} - 1) GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.pay_time) ORDER BY date_trunc('month', o.pay_time)

SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.plan_code AS plan_code, p.plan_name AS plan_name, COUNT(1) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS paid_amount FROM billing_order o JOIN plan p ON p.id = o.plan_id WHERE
GROUP BY p.id, p.plan_code, p.plan_name ORDER BY paid_amount DESC, p.id

SELECT o.pay_method AS pay_method, COUNT(1) AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS paid_amount FROM billing_order o WHERE
GROUP BY o.pay_method ORDER BY pay_method

SELECT COUNT(1) AS statements, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 2), 0) AS settled_amount, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 1), 0) AS pending_amount, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 3), 0) AS overdue_amount, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 3) AS overdue_count FROM billing_statement s WHERE s.is_deleted = FALSE
